meta.title: EndPoint. The digital twin for electrical and MEP contractors
meta.description: EndPoint. brings everything an electrical or MEP contractor knows into one place: clients, contracts, prices and every project. First application: the final invoice.

hero.sub: EndPoint. brings your company's knowledge into one place: clients, contracts, prices and every project, with everything that was built, changed and agreed. Every number leads back to its source.

problem.title: What a company knows about a project is everywhere. Just not in one place.

items.title: Scattered
items.text: Bills of quantities in the ERP, instructions in emails, daywork sheets on paper, photos on phones. At the end of a project someone has to piece it all together.

items.title: Informal
items.text: Much of the work on site is agreed by phone, by word of mouth and on WhatsApp. What was never written down is missing later as evidence.

items.title: Tied to people
items.text: When a project manager leaves, the knowledge leaves too. In electrical installation, more than 70 % of open positions remain unfilled.

items.title: Uneven
items.text: Clients increasingly check subcontractor invoices with software, line by line against the bill of quantities, contract and measurements.

twin.title: A model of your business. From the company down to a single piece of evidence.
twin.sub: Click on a project. It holds everything that was built, changed, instructed and paid, and where we know it from.

wege.title: The twin fills up where the work happens.

tabs.title: Connect
tabs.text: ERP, estimating and CRM stay in charge. EndPoint. reads master data, projects, bills of quantities, invoices and payments, and adds what is missing there.

tabs.title: Upload
tabs.text: No system? The project folder is enough. Every file becomes a record with source, page and location. Duplicates and new plan revisions are detected.

tabs.title: Voice in
tabs.text: Fitters and foremen send a photo and a voice note via WhatsApp. An agent assigns it, asks briefly if needed, and the sender confirms with one tap.

apps.title: Applications run on the twin. The first one is the final invoice.

first.label: Application 1
first.title: Final invoice
first.text: The project twin knows what was delivered and what was invoiced. From that, the draft final invoice is created, and every line has evidence. Click on an amount.

evidence: Plan revision C → D, rooms 5 to 9
Email from site management: “please do it right away”

planned.title: Portfolio
planned.text: All projects, open amounts and deadlines at a glance.

planned.title: Client history
planned.text: What a client cuts, accepts and how they pay.

planned.title: Deadlines
planned.text: Deadlines and securities across all projects.

items.title: Every number has a source
items.text: File, page, location. For voice notes: message, photo, audio.

items.title: People confirm
items.text: AI provides facts and suggestions. Your people decide.

items.title: The math is code
items.text: Amounts are calculated by deterministic code, not by a language model.

items.title: Nothing is overwritten
items.text: Every change is a new version with time and origin.

items.title: Your data stays yours
items.text: One data silo per company. You decide which projects go in.

items.title: We never talk to your client
items.text: EndPoint. works only for you and with your people. No evaluation of individual employees.

insider.title: Construction insider
insider.text: You know billing, change orders and final account meetings in electrical or MEP? Then we should talk.
